output.title: ACME package fork: user-facing effect and ACME use not shown
output.content: The release note (ev-4fcf47388827) says only that cert-manager now uses a local fork of `golang.org/x/crypto/acme`. It does not describe any change in behaviour, configuration or API. This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0, but the summary does not show whether ACME is used: the only cert-manager manifest is `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate`, no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests appear, and the CRDs dimension is absent. The values key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` is set, which points at HTTP challenge RBAC, so check whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer uses ACME and read PR #7752 to see if the fork changes ACME behaviour.
